meta.title: Protocol for the generation of three-dimensional micropatterned neuroepithelial tissues using hPSCs, bioprinting, and matrix scaffolds.

extracted_by: Claude (Claude Code session), pending human review
summary: A protocol that prints droplets of extracellular matrix to confine human pluripotent stem cells, so they self-assemble into single-lumen, neural-tube-like neuroepithelial tissues.

formulations.review_notes: Matrix is printed; cells are seeded onto the printed droplets.
formulations.name: Cultrex ECM droplets (micropatterning)
formulations.composition_detail: Cultrex basement membrane extract printed as droplets
formulations.key_outcome: Printed ECM droplets restrict hPSC growth to start single-lumen neural tube-like tissues.
